title: Route companion
idea: Route companion: A waypoint instruction sits above an expandable route
audience: People who need to navigate within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Movement depends on the next waypoint
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic spatial layout through its navigate priority and explicit commitment contract: Label stale directions and never claim live location without permission
navigation: Route companion keeps the current navigate context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A waypoint instruction sits above an expandable route
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to navigate; movement depends on the next waypoint
composition.priority: Label stale directions and never claim live location without permission

imagery.role: Support the actual navigate context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep the next instruction visible when map detail expands
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the route companion structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no navigate content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Label stale directions and never claim live location without permission
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized navigate content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Label stale directions and never claim live location without permission
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active navigate context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
